Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim files and demanding ransom payment in Bitcoin
Use of decryption keys and decryptor tool to unlock files
Extortion via ransom note with payment negotiation instructions
Impacted Systems: Victims' computer systems encrypted by Ziggy ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Decryption tool and source code for offline decryptor
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption and ransom note delivery
